tools.name: publish_strategy

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: Lists public FinzData Hub strategies. sort: robust (deflated Sharpe), forward (forward Sharpe, 63+ days of out-of-sample record), new, forks. Optional family (momentum, expr, ma_cross, factor).

tools.name: star_strategy

tools.name: comment_strategy

tools.description: Retrieve a verified strategy record by its ID.

tools.name: verified_board
tools.description: Get the leaderboard of verified strategies.

tools.name: retire_strategy
tools.description: Retire one of your verified strategy records: it stops accruing new forward results, keeps its full history and stays public on the Verified board marked retired.

tools.description: finds financial MCP servers graded nightly by FinzData for health, protocol conformance and prompt-injection risk; results include install URLs.

tools.description: retrieves a financial MCP server listing with tools, probe history, issues and verified-data status.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "run_backtest" is 1599 chars, far longer than this server's median (165). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Runs a deterministic backtest from a JSON spec (universe, start, end, signal, rebalance, top_n, costs_bps, side='long'|'long_short', blind=true to hide tickers)…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: star_strategy, search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_server · Private data: backtest_export, run_backtest, publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, register_strategy, get_verified_record, verify_chain, retire_strategy, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, retire_strategy · Destructive: backtest_export, run_backtest, compare_runs, publish_strategy, translate_stockcharts_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: star_strategy, search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_server · Private data: backtest_export, run_backtest, publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, register_strategy, get_verified_record, verify_chain, retire_strategy, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, retire_strategy · Destructive: backtest_export, run_backtest, compare_runs, publish_strategy, translate_stockcharts_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
